description: Queries Athena Health using client_credentials OAuth 2.0 authentication and pushes matching patient resources downstream as JSON. Supports both the proprietary REST API and the FHIR R4 API.

config.label: Interval
config.description: How often, in milliseconds, the runtime invokes the polling script.

config.label: Base URL
config.description: Root URL of the Athena Health API platform. The token endpoint and API paths are appended to it. Use https://api.preview.platform.athenahealth.com/ for sandbox. A trailing slash is added if omitted.

config.label: Client ID
config.description: The OAuth client identifier assigned to your application on the Athena developer portal.

config.label: Client Secret
config.description: The OAuth client secret paired with the Client ID. Never stored in plaintext.

config.label: Scopes
config.description: OAuth scopes requested when obtaining an access token, space-separated.

config.label: Practice ID
config.description: The Athena practice identifier used in proprietary REST API paths (v1/<practice_id>/...).

config.label: Search Query
config.description: Search parameters as a URL query string, for example firstname=John&lastname=Smith. Leave empty to search without filters.

config.label: Live Mode
config.description: When off, API requests are simulated and no data leaves the runtime, which is useful while wiring up a workflow. Authentication is always performed live so credential problems surface immediately.

config.label: Verify TLS
config.description: Whether to verify the Athena server's TLS certificate. Leave on outside of local testing against a proxy.
